rule: Every retained run carries a decision and is reported on its own; numbers from different suites are never combined into one figure.

suites.claim: 11 rule benches, each with at least 6 labelled attack shapes; every shape is caught on at least one real surface (gate or tree scan), and a cold control stays uncaught.
suites.failure: A miss becomes a KNOWN-GAPS entry or a rule fix; it is never relabelled benign to keep the suite green.
assumptions: fixtures are hand-written, not sampled from real incidents
each case exercises an intended surface
blindSpots: shapes not listed in the fixtures are not measured
does not show that a host enforced any block

suites.claim: 11 rule benches, each with at least 10 legitimate shapes, fire zero times and produce no scorer error.
suites.failure: A firing is a false-positive defect: fix the rule or record a deliberate exception; never delete the fixture to pass.
assumptions: fixtures represent ordinary work, not every possible legitimate shape
blindSpots: fits the fixture set only; a shape outside it can still be blocked
one adjudicated exception is documented in the scoreboard

suites.claim: install, block, offline explanation, checkpoint and undo run end-to-end through the packed CLI with the intended exit codes, and init stays under the 3 s budget.
suites.failure: A failure means the user-facing path is not ready; fix the integration before shipping.
assumptions: runs on this machine with Bun and Git available
blindSpots: does not exercise a real host session

suites.claim: A coarse 0-4 structural rubric scores explanation text offline (presence of plain-language reason and fix), with no model call.
suites.failure: A regression means the rubric broke; it does not mean explanation quality improved or degraded in a live call.
assumptions: structure is a weak proxy for usefulness
blindSpots: no live provider output is involved

suites.claim: Per-rule precision and recall floors hold against a pinned baseline over a held-out corpus, with an unknown ceiling and no lost true negatives.
suites.failure: A regression or lost TN fails the run; a new TN requires review and an explicit baseline update.
assumptions: floors are project policy, not measured generality
blindSpots: an unknown case is counted separately and never as a pass

suites.claim: Labelled adversarial scenarios S1-S8b behave as recorded, including a no-bypass check on the CLI surface.
suites.failure: Any S-label regression blocks the change.
assumptions: one scenario per label, with a fixed payload
blindSpots: does not cover refusal behaviour, which lives outside deterministic tests

suites.claim: Five user-facing proof beats hold: leak stopped, harmful operations blocked while benign work proceeds, a failing check yields a fail verdict, undo restores, and a real hook blocks an unsafe commit.
suites.failure: A failing beat means a user-facing claim is false; correct the claim or the product before shipping.
assumptions: hooks run through the installed path
blindSpots: does not prove host trust or execution

skipped.claim: An actor write, the fence mirror, fetched evidence and a trusted oracle describe the same episode under a fake transport.
skipped.reason: The code exists only on the local-only eval/live-loops-local branch; it is not published and its isolation boundary is not proven.
skipped.decision: Stays skipped until the isolation and scoring phase is completed on that private branch; no model-generated code is executed.

skipped.claim: Provider retries and a durable ledger bound paid dispatch across restarts.
skipped.reason: Provider and ledger code is private-branch only; no paid authorization exists.
skipped.decision: Stays skipped; no dispatch is proposed without a durable bound and explicit authorization.

notAdded.reason: No deterministic, independently checkable outcome can be defined without a real host or sandbox; a simulated deploy would measure the simulation.
Model behaviour is not deterministic; a fixture could not decide pass or fail independently of a live model.
Depends on host approval UX and user response; no deterministic fixture exists.
